projectName: Leg Renames and a Six-Leg Route

dimensions.label: Problem Clarity
dimensions.evidence: The route's eight leg ids mix verbs and nouns, two legs (`refine`, `contract`) book the same carrier with no gate between them, and one leg (`ideate`) carries `stampCmd: false` because it leaves no papers — forcing the `ideateIsDone` backwards special case at src/legs.js:131-133 and the hardcoded index-0 branch at src/inference.js:140-146.

dimensions.label: Goal Definition
dimensions.evidence: Countable targets: six legs where there were eight, zero special-cased legs in inference, every leg id reading as the work its booking does, and `/waybill:new` absorbing the brainstorm as an off-route on-ramp that hands off to `/waybill:bay`.

dimensions.label: Success Criteria
dimensions.evidence: `node --test tests/` is the repo's only mechanical gate (package.json:15; no lint, typecheck or build), reinforced by eleven cmd checks that each pair a positive assertion with a negative one so none can pass vacuously — a shape the success-criteria critic forced after finding two that could not fail.

dimensions.label: Scope Boundaries
dimensions.evidence: In: src/legs.js, src/inference.js, the booking files, commands/new.md and src/cli.js's booking lookup, 33 goldens, ~230 test assertions across 12 files, two new test cases, and the prose surfaces including openspec/specs/. Out: every item from the gate-focus discussion, and any overlay migration.

dimensions.label: Consistency
dimensions.evidence: One contradiction surfaced and was resolved deliberately: `/waybill:new` will propose a branch name while commands/bay.md:91 says "do not invent a branch, and do not pick one for me" — recorded as a decision, and deferred to the Full tier because it traces to no problem paragraph.

problem: Waybill's route is eight legs, and the names have drifted out of any single scheme. Five are verbs (`ideate`, `refine`, `execute`, `review`, `cleanup`), two are nouns (`contract`, `specs`), and exactly one — `bay` — speaks the freight vocabulary the rest of the tool is built from (waybill, docket, stamp, booking, carrier, trunk). A half-committed metaphor reads worse than either whole one, and the leg name is the single word a waybill shows you most often.

Two of the eight legs are not really two. `refine` and `contract` both book `/ideation:ideation`, one after the other, with no human gate between them; they differ only in which file they stamp (`contract-data.json` then `contract.md`). One carrier, two positions.

One of the eight is not really a leg. `ideate` carries `stampCmd: false` because rough ideation leaves nothing on disk by design, so waybill has to judge it backwards from repository state instead. That single exception is what forces `ideateIsDone` (src/legs.js:131-133) and the hardcoded index-0 branch in the inference walk (src/inference.js:140-146). It is also already a fiction: `/waybill:new` runs the brainstorm in-session rather than handing it off, which is the opposite of what every other leg does, and new.md's own frontmatter comment explains at length why it must break the rule.

The cost lands on the only person who runs the route: every leg of every effort shows a name from an inconsistent scheme, `/waybill:next` walks a list with one member the model cannot judge on its own evidence, and the guide has to explain why leg 1 works differently from the other seven.
goals: LEGS is exactly six ids in route order: bay, ideate, specify, execute, review, cleanup.

Every leg id reads as the work its booking does, and every leg is judged by papers on disk — zero legs judged backwards, zero special cases in the inference walk. Three ids match their carrier only by namespace rather than literally (`ideate` books /ideation:ideation, `specify` books /spec:propose, `execute` books /spec:apply); this goal does not license renaming any skill or any further leg.
`ideateIsDone` and the index-0 branch in src/inference.js are deleted — not inlined, not relocated.
`/waybill:new` runs the brainstorm off-route and ends with a pasteable `/waybill:bay` handoff.

Today's `bookings/ideation-ideate.md` survives, renamed to `ideation-brainstorm.md`, as a booking that is not a leg — and a machine overlay can still rebook its carrier, proved by a test that exercises the rebooking rather than asserted in prose.

No surface still names `refine`, `contract` or `specs` as a leg, or claims a route length of seven or eight — covering src, bookings, commands, goldens, tests, the root README.md, all four files under docs/guide/, and openspec/specs/command-surface/spec.md.

successCriteria.criterion: The whole suite is green — the only mechanical gate this repo has.
LEGS is exactly the six expected ids in route order, pinned by an assertion that exists rather than by a promise in prose.
No retired leg id survives anywhere in src/ or in booking frontmatter.

check.cmd: grep -q "'specify'" src/legs.js && ! grep -rqE "'(refine|contract|specs)'" src/ && ! grep -rqE '^leg: (refine|contract|specs)$' bookings/
check.expect: exits 0 — the positive half proves the grep can match at all, so neither negative half can pass vacuously

successCriteria.criterion: The brainstorm special case is deleted rather than inlined: neither the helper nor the index-0 skip it existed to serve remains.
The brainstorm keeps a booking file, is absent from the route, and has an assertion saying so.

check.cmd: test -f bookings/ideation-brainstorm.md && grep -q 'ideation-brainstorm' tests/bookings.test.js && node --test tests/bookings.test.js

successCriteria.criterion: A machine overlay can still rebook the brainstorm carrier — the only surviving justification for keeping it a booking, so it is exercised rather than claimed.
An overlay binding a retired leg id degrades to a doctor warning rather than taking doctor down with it — the evidence behind treating the machine-local breakage as out of scope.

check.expect: exits 0; today's only overlay-warn case uses a duplicate-leg fixture, so this pins a retired-leg case being added

successCriteria.criterion: Every golden that carries a leg line reports a six-leg route, and none reports any other length.

check.cmd: grep -rqE 'leg [1-6] of 6 \(' tests/golden/ && ! grep -rqE 'leg [0-9]+ of [^6]' tests/golden/

successCriteria.criterion: The guide's waybill samples still match a leg golden each — the coupling that stops the walkthrough drifting from the route.
The prose surfaces outside the guide's mechanical coupling carry no retired leg id and no stale route length, so phase 4 cannot be skipped silently.

check.cmd: node --test tests/guide.test.js && ! grep -rnE '(seven|eight) legs|leg [0-9]+ of [78]|`(refine|specs)`' README.md docs/guide/ openspec/specs/command-surface/spec.md openspec/changes/add-help-card/
check.expect: exits 0; bare `contract` is excluded from the pattern because it is a legitimate artifact word in this repo, and openspec/changes/archive/ is excluded because it is a historical record

successCriteria.criterion: `/waybill:new` renders a pasteable `/waybill:bay` handoff and no leg position, pinned as a golden of its own.

check.cmd: node --test tests/cli.test.js tests/commands.test.js && grep -q '/waybill:bay ' tests/golden/new.txt && ! grep -qE 'leg [0-9]+ of' tests/golden/new.txt
check.expect: exits 0; no new.* golden exists today, so this also pins that phase 2 creates one — the old ideate.txt/.md goldens now belong to the renamed ideate leg

successCriteria.criterion: The branch name `/waybill:new` proposes actually follows from the brainstorm conclusion rather than being a generic slug.

check.judgment: Run /waybill:new after a brainstorm and read the proposed name; only a human can tell whether it names the effort well. The structural halves are covered by the cmd check above.

mvp.item: src/legs.js: six legs, new ids, `ideateIsDone` deleted
mvp.reason: The LEGS array is the route; every downstream consumer derives from it.

mvp.item: src/inference.js: delete the index-0 backwards-judging branch at :140-146
mvp.reason: It exists only to serve the leg being removed. Both statements go — deleting the helper while inlining the skip is the failure goal 3 names.

mvp.item: Booking files: a three-way rename — `ideation-ideate.md`→`ideation-brainstorm.md`, `ideation-contract.md`→`ideation-ideate.md`, `openspec-specs.md`→`openspec-specify.md` — with `ideation-refine.md` deleted into the merged booking and tests/commands.test.js:213 re-pointed
mvp.reason: Bookings index on the `leg:` frontmatter field, so every retired id is a load-time throw until fixed. The shuffle collides on the name `ideation-ideate.md`, and the model/effort pin at tests/commands.test.js:213 matches by literal filename against bookings that are all opus/high — so left unstated it silently starts asserting against the merged contract booking and still passes.

mvp.item: tests/fixtures/: `ideate.js`→`brainstorm.js`, `refine.js`+`contract.js` merged into a new `ideate.js`, `specs.js`→`specify.js`, directory down from 9 files to 7
mvp.reason: tests/inference.test.js:100 asserts `readdirSync(FIXTURES).length === LEGS.length + 1`, and five suites import the chain (inference, waybill, cli, booking-swap, bookings-overlay). Carries the same filename collision as the bookings.

mvp.item: One exported constant of off-route booking ids in src/legs.js, folded into the knownLegs set the existing call sites already build
mvp.reason: resolveBookings only rejects an id absent from the caller-supplied set (src/bookings.js:97-99), and the call sites already construct it from LEGS (src/cli.js:87, src/doctor.js:29, src/help.js:122, src/inference.js:75). Explicitly not: a new frontmatter key, an `offRoute` field on Booking, or a second loader.

mvp.item: commands/new.md and src/cli.js: a by-name brainstorm booking lookup, plus a `/waybill:bay` handoff block
mvp.reason: src/cli.js:424,428 resolve the booking through `LEGS[0]`, which no longer names the brainstorm; the warning at src/cli.js:435 rewords. src/waybill.js gains no pre-route mode, flag or parameter — `position()` already returns `no docket open` on this path (src/waybill.js:65-69), and tests/golden/ideate.md:2 confirms `new` prints no leg position today.

mvp.item: Two new test cases: a doctor overlay bound to a retired leg id, and a booking-swap case rebooking the brainstorm carrier
mvp.reason: Both back claims the contract otherwise only asserts — that doctor covers the machine-local breakage, and that keeping the brainstorm a booking buys rebookability. Without them, two criteria pass regardless of the change.

mvp.item: All 33 goldens in tests/golden/, plus a new `new.txt`
mvp.reason: Byte-exact assert.equal comparisons with no regeneration mechanism; nearly every one embeds the route length, and `new`'s output can no longer share the ideate goldens.
Heaviest in tests/inference.test.js; tests/legs.test.js's index-1 anchor and its stated rationale both change, and booking-swap/fleet/inspection-gitignore each carry leg ids.

mvp.item: Prose surfaces: root README.md, all four files under docs/guide/ (including docs/guide/README.md), and the three `fix/specs` sites at src/cli.js:93, tests/cli.test.js:448-450 and openspec/specs/command-surface/spec.md:104-105
mvp.reason: Per the next-from-anywhere learning, waybill documents its behavior well outside src/. `fix/specs` is a branch chosen to collide with a leg id and prove the parser disambiguates; it tests nothing once that id retires.

full.item: `/waybill:new` proposes a concrete branch name rather than printing a `/waybill:bay <branch>` placeholder
full.reason: Deferred a tier because it traces to no problem paragraph — the problem statement is entirely about the naming scheme, the refine/contract merge, and the ideate special case. It is also the one in-scope item not forced by the byte-exact-golden argument, so deferring it costs no rework. Kept in the plan because it is the behavior chosen at interview.

outOfScope.item: Making `/waybill:next` gate-aware — a `gate:` field, a "next gate, N legs out" line, or changing what `next` hands you
outOfScope.reason: A separate effort; this change deliberately leaves next's behavior untouched.

outOfScope.item: Re-modelling `contract → specs` and `review → cleanup` as human stops
outOfScope.reason: Two genuinely mis-modelled handovers found during the brainstorm, but they belong to the gate effort, not the rename.

outOfScope.item: Any migration or repair of the user's `~/.waybill/bookings` overlay
outOfScope.reason: src/doctor.js:405-429 already catches the throw, reports warn rather than fail precisely so doctor stays runnable, and names the offending leg and file. A release-note line covers discovery; the new doctor test case above is what makes this claim checkable.

outOfScope.item: Pointing overlay failure messages at `waybill doctor`
outOfScope.reason: A real one-line gap, but it improves every overlay failure rather than anything this rename introduces — TODO, not scope.

outOfScope.item: Renaming any skill, or any leg beyond the four named here
outOfScope.reason: Goal 2 is about legibility, not literal carrier matching; three ids match only by namespace and that is accepted.

outOfScope.item: A version number anywhere in the specs
outOfScope.reason: Per the bang-line-exit-guard learning: main releases independently and release PRs own versioning, so a spec naming a version goes stale.

decisions.decision: Name each leg for the work its booking does
decisions.rejected: Name each leg for its stamp — the artifact it leaves behind
decisions.reason: Stamp-naming was the stronger principle in the abstract (waybill is a stamp-reader), but carrier-naming reads better against the booking file and fixes the verb/noun mix at the same time. Stated limit, after the scope-creep critic showed the literal version is false for half the route: `ideate`, `specify` and `execute` match their carriers only by namespace.

decisions.decision: Merge `refine` into `contract` and call the result `ideate`
decisions.reason: One carrier, two sequential positions, no human gate between. contract.md is strictly downstream of contract-data.json, so the merged leg stamps on contract.md alone and loses no coverage.

decisions.decision: The merged `ideate` leg inherits `handover: transfer` from `refine`
decisions.reason: The ideation interview is long and expensive and previously got a fresh session. Inheriting `through` would run it in the same context that already held the whole brainstorm.

decisions.decision: Collapse the brainstorm leg into `/waybill:new` and drop it from the route
decisions.reason: It was the route's only leg that could not be judged from its own papers, which forced two special cases in the source. `/waybill:new` already ran it in-session rather than handing it off, so the leg was a fiction wrapped around a command that never behaved like the other seven. Consequence accepted: a docket now begins at a branch, and there is no waybill state at all during a brainstorm.

decisions.decision: Keep `bookings/ideation-brainstorm.md` as a booking that is not a leg, and prove the rebookability with a test
decisions.reason: Preserves per-machine rebooking of the brainstorm carrier. Note a justification withdrawn under the scope-creep critic: tests/commands.test.js:204-216 reads the booking by filename via parseFrontmatter, not through loadBookings, so that pin needs only a file on disk and never argued for a load path. Rebookability is now the sole justification, which is why it gets its own criterion.

decisions.decision: `/waybill:new` proposes a concrete branch name in its `/waybill:bay` handoff, at the Full tier
decisions.reason: The brainstorm conclusion is exactly the context that makes the name inferable, and it mirrors how ideation names its own project rather than asking. It deliberately inverts commands/bay.md:91 — "do not invent a branch, and do not pick one for me from whatever we were last working on" — for this one path, and must be written down where a later reader will find it. Tiered to Full because the scope-creep critic showed it traces to no problem paragraph.

decisions.decision: Ship the rename, the leg removal, and the `new` rework as one change
decisions.rejected: Split into two PRs, in either order
decisions.reason: All 33 goldens are byte-exact and nearly every one embeds the route length, so a split rewrites every one of them twice and ships an intermediate seven-leg route nobody wants. This overrides the standing AGENTS.md preference for small incremental PRs, consciously.

decisions.decision: Treat the machine-local overlay breakage as a release note, backed by a new doctor test
decisions.rejected: Build a migration, or extend `waybill doctor` to recognise the rename
decisions.reason: src/doctor.js:405-429 already catches the resolveBookings throw and degrades it to warn so doctor survives on the broken machine. The success-criteria critic found the claim unverified — the only existing overlay-warn test uses a duplicate-leg fixture, not a retired id — so one test case comes into scope to make the out-of-scope decision honest.

decisions.decision: Carry the off-route brainstorm booking as one exported id constant folded into the existing knownLegs sets
decisions.rejected: A second booking category — an `offRoute` frontmatter key, an `offRoute` field on Booking, or a parallel loader function
decisions.reason: Raised by the over-engineering critic: the pre-revision scope said only "a load path for a booking that is deliberately not a leg", which invites building a category for exactly one file. resolveBookings already rejects only ids absent from the caller-supplied set, so widening that set is the whole change.

decisions.decision: `/waybill:new` keeps src/waybill.js untouched; only the booking lookup, the warning text, and the appended handoff change
decisions.rejected: A pre-route rendering mode in src/waybill.js
decisions.reason: Raised by the over-engineering critic, and the pre-revision scope rested on a factual error: it claimed `new` could no longer print `leg 1 of N`. It never printed one — `position()` (src/waybill.js:65-69) short-circuits to `no docket open` against firstLeg's hardcoded `docketOpen: false`, and tests/golden/ideate.md:2 shows exactly that.

decisions.decision: The ride-along's leg headings and waybill fences move into the goldens phase
decisions.rejected: Keeping all guide edits together in the prose phase
decisions.reason: Raised by the hidden-dependency critic: tests/guide.test.js:134-143 deep-equals the `## Leg N · <id>` headings against LEGS and :145-158 requires each leg golden's bytes to appear verbatim as a fence. The guide and the goldens are two halves of one assertion, so the original ordering left the suite red across a phase boundary and made the whole-suite criterion unsatisfiable until the last phase.

decisions.decision: Accept that three leg ids match their carrier only by plugin namespace
decisions.rejected: Renaming the vendored spec commands so `specify` and `execute` match literally
decisions.reason: Raised by both the scope-creep and hidden-dependency critics. Making it literally true means renaming commands/spec/propose.md and apply.md, which pulls in src/doctor.js:215-258's required-set symlink check and its hardcoded message at :256 naming the bare /spec:propose and /spec:apply, plus every machine's existing symlinks. Far outside a rename.

decisions.decision: Every cmd check pairs a positive assertion with its negative half
decisions.rejected: Bare negated greps and criteria whose distinguishing content lives in the `expect` prose
decisions.reason: The success-criteria critic found two criteria that could not fail and four whose substance was unexecuted prose. A negated grep passes for free when nothing can ever emit the string, so each one now carries a twin that proves the pattern is matchable.

execution.strategy: Hybrid — phase 1 gates everything; phases 2 and 3 then run as a parallel wave (disjoint files: cli/commands vs doctor/booking-swap); phase 4 joins them; phase 5 follows.

phases.title: The route model
phases.notes: src/legs.js down to six legs with the new ids and `ideateIsDone` deleted; src/inference.js:140-146's index-0 branch removed entirely rather than inlined. THE BOOKING SHUFFLE IS THREE-WAY AND COLLIDES — do it in this order: `ideation-ideate.md` (today's brainstorm booking) → `ideation-brainstorm.md`; `ideation-contract.md` → `ideation-ideate.md`, absorbing refine's body and keeping the `contract.md` stamp; delete `ideation-refine.md`; `openspec-specs.md` → `openspec-specify.md`. Then re-point tests/commands.test.js:213 from `'ideation-ideate.md'` to `'ideation-brainstorm.md'` — all three ideation bookings are opus/high, so left alone that pin silently asserts against the merged contract booking and still passes, leaving the brainstorm booking unpinned. THE SAME COLLISION HITS tests/fixtures/: `ideate.js` → `brainstorm.js`, `refine.js` + `contract.js` merge into a new `ideate.js`, `specs.js` → `specify.js`; the directory must drop 9 files to 7 because tests/inference.test.js:100 asserts `readdirSync(FIXTURES).length === LEGS.length + 1`, and five suites import it (inference, waybill, cli, booking-swap, bookings-overlay). src/legs.js gains one exported constant of off-route booking ids, folded into the knownLegs set the four existing call sites already build (src/cli.js:87, src/doctor.js:29, src/help.js:122, src/inference.js:75) — under two constraints: the brainstorm booking must keep `stampCmd: false` (src/bookings.js:91-96 throws on a booking with no stamp), and it must not surface as a key in the bookings map, because tests/inference.test.js:114 deep-equals those keys against KNOWN_LEGS. Name which map, if any, hands the off-route booking to `new`. Tests: legs.test.js (its index-1 anchor and stated rationale both change), bookings.test.js, booking-swap.test.js, inference.test.js, frontmatter.test.js.

phases.title: The new on-ramp
phases.notes: commands/new.md and src/cli.js: swap the `LEGS[0].id` / `bookings.get(LEGS[0].id)` lookups at src/cli.js:424,428 for a by-name brainstorm lookup, reword the leg-1 warning at src/cli.js:435, append the `/waybill:bay` handoff block, and add a `new.txt` golden. src/waybill.js is untouched. The Full-tier branch-name proposal lands here if that tier is targeted. Tests: cli.test.js, commands.test.js.

phases.title: Evidence for the out-of-scope claims
phases.notes: Two test cases the critics forced: a doctor case writing an overlay with a retired leg id and asserting the bookings row is WARN matching /unknown leg/ (today's only overlay-warn case at tests/doctor.test.js:401 uses a duplicate-leg fixture), and a booking-swap case rebooking the brainstorm carrier through an overlay. Small and independent of phase 2, but depends on phase 1 for the retired ids to exist.

phases.title: Goldens, the ride-along, and the test sweep
phases.notes: All 33 byte-exact goldens, renamed per leg id where tests/guide.test.js:145-158's LEGS-derived map requires it, plus a new `new.txt`. docs/guide/01-ride-along.md's `## Leg N · <id>` headings and its ```waybill fences belong to THIS phase, not the prose phase: tests/guide.test.js:134-143 deep-equals those headings against LEGS, and :145-158 requires each leg golden's bytes to appear verbatim as a fence — the guide and the goldens are two halves of one assertion, so splitting them leaves the suite red across a phase boundary. Remaining assertions in waybill.test.js, help.test.js, review.test.js, fleet.test.js (src/fleet.js:15,23 comments name "leg 2 … leg 8" and "a branch mid-refine") and inspection-gitignore.test.js. Goldens come after the code settles on purpose: they are snapshots of final output, and updating them mid-stream means updating them twice.

prereqs: Goldens, the ride-along, and the test sweep
phases.notes: Everything guide.test.js does NOT mechanically couple, which is why it lands last: root README.md (:3 "eight legs", the route table, :157's sample), docs/guide/01-ride-along.md's remaining tick strips and prose (its headings and fences went in phase 4), docs/guide/02-glossary.md:32,39, docs/guide/README.md:13, docs/guide/03-reference.md's allowed-value list and worked example. Also the three `fix/specs` sites (src/cli.js:93, tests/cli.test.js:448-450, openspec/specs/command-surface/spec.md:104-105) re-pointed at a surviving id, plus two surfaces the hidden-dependency critic found: openspec/specs/command-surface/spec.md:96 names the refine leg outside the fix/specs scenario, and the live unarchived change openspec/changes/add-help-card/ names retired legs at design.md:25-27, its eight-leg route table at design.md:195-198, and a requirement scenario pinning refine/contract/specs stamps at specs/help-card/spec.md:82-83.
